text: Is this holy water? It sure looks wet...
It looks like a holy symbol for Evdos.
That's probably not meant for heathen eyes.
"Evdos, Keeper of Knowledge, speaks unto you this day. Bend not only the knee, but also the mind. Reverence without understanding is empty."
"A city built on strength alone shall fall. But a city built on knowledge, mercy, memory, and honest trade shall endure."
"Honor also Ylarus, God of Time, who measures the hour and appoints the season. Nothing ripens before its proper moment."
"Knowledge without patience becomes arrogance, and patience without knowledge becomes slumber. Evdos gives light to understand, and Ylarus gives the hour for understanding to bear fruit."
"Beware Ulrog, God of Power. His servants whisper that might is wisdom and conquest is proof. They promise glory, yet they bring ruin, broken households, and ashes."

"Guard your children's minds as you guard their bodies. Teach them to read, to reason, to remember, and to question with humility. Ignorance is Ulrog's gate, but wisdom is the lamp of Evdos, and patience the watch of Ylarus."

"When fear takes root in your streets, say not, 'We are abandoned,' but, 'Our hour has come to choose well.' Choose knowledge over ignorance, patience over panic, and truth over power. Evdos enlightens, Ylarus endures, and Ulrog consumes."
The map of Lastdenn is old and worn, but it still shows the layout of the city.
